layout.selection: Boolean fourth CreateDib argument chooses selection of created bitmap into the new HDC. Caller resize path supplies true and no palette.

observations.header: Destroy old DIB before allocation. Width/height copied as signed input ints without negation/absolute value; depth truncated to16bits. BI_RGB40byte header. SizeImage is original uint32 stride result times signed height modulo32. Normal texture resize supplies positive width/height, hence bottom-up. Do not infer that every decoded source image has the same orientation.
observations.trueColorStride: For clrUsed0 and depth outside1/4/8, original uint32 expression is ((depth16*width32+31)>>3)&0x1ffffffc. Multiplication/addition wrap at32bits. For ordinary positive24/32bit dimensions this is DWORD-aligned row bytes.
observations.indexedStride: If clrUsed nonzero or depth1/4/8, helper computes ((uintWidth/(8/depth16))+3)&0xfffffffc with integer division. It truncates packed-pixel tails instead of the usual ceil rule. For incompatible combinations division by zero is possible. This observed quirk is NOT silently replaced with a standard stride algorithm and is not proof the original low-depth runtime safely accepts every width.
observations.nativeAllocation: CreateDIBSection(NULL,header,DIB_RGB_COLORS0,&bits,NULL,0), then CreateCompatibleDC(NULL) and MFC CDC attach thunk. A zero bits pointer/HDC or failed attach triggers DestroyDib and null return. Header allocation failure returns null. No explicit pixel-fill loop in inspected creation body. SelectObject return is stored without checking HGDI_ERROR; do not treat static return as proof of actual native selection success.
observations.defaultState: Inspected constructor initializes owned handles/pointers to0 after embedded CDC constructor. No SetStretchBltMode/SetBrushOrgEx call observed in these five bodies. External MFC thunks and OS-created DC defaults are not independently proved by this audit.
observations.resampleCaller: Existing hash-locked wrapper1ad030 sets HALFTONE4 iff signed integer sourceWidth/destWidth>=2 OR sourceHeight/destHeight>=2. Shrinks smaller than2x retain DC mode. It then StretchBlt SRCCOPY0xcc0020 and separately repairs32bit alpha by source OR helper. No direct SetBrushOrgEx call observed in that wrapper. Public documentation recommends brush-origin setup; do not add it to a source-faithful oracle without observing the actual effective origin.
observations.selection: DCSelectBitmap(true) fails if CDC pointer/HBITMAP absent; selects only when oldBitmap0. False clears oldBitmap before restoring it; failure leaves field0. Already-selected/already-unselected cases return1.
observations.cleanup: DestroyDib frees resource/header, restores/deletes palette, detaches CDC, restores old bitmap, deletes HBITMAP and HDC, then zeros all owned pointers. Real native cleanup result/driver behavior is not inferred from these static calls.
